atlas-funded.Split scaling: 90% standard; 100% via +20% checkout add-on (CFD programs). Futures 90% flat.
atlas-funded.Leverage: up to 1:100 (CFD; 1:50 on MT5 Access funded)
atlas-funded.Payout frequency: CFD: first payout 14 days after funded account is created, then every 14 days (Access: 28 days first; 1-Step/2-Step Daily: on demand Mon-Fri; Weekly and On-Demand add-ons). Futures: on request once profit goal reached (Atlas Daily: once per trading day), capped per payout.
atlas-funded.Consistency rule: None on 1-Step, 2-Step, Daily and Instant Zero; Instant Funded 20%; Access funded 40%. Futures: Standard 50% to pass / 40% funded, Apex & Daily 40% to pass / none funded, Direct 20%.
atlas-funded.Discount code: SPOOKY (45% off CFD accounts (40% futures, 25% Atlas Daily))
atlas-funded.x:Reset / retry: CFD: reset priced as a multiple of what you paid — 1-Step phase 1 0.85x / funded 1.15x; 2-Step 0.85x / 1.15x / funded 1.55x; Instant 0.85x; Access $5 (funded 1.55x funded fee); offer valid 7 days after breach. Futures: evaluation reset 90% of price paid (one per evaluation); funded reactivation once at 3x plan price; Direct cannot be reset.
atlas-funded.x:Fee refund: Used (traded) accounts non-refundable; unused accounts may be refunded within 7 days at Atlas discretion. Evaluation fee returned with 3rd funded payout (1-Step/2-Step/Daily), 4th (Access), 5th (Instant). Add-ons never refunded.
atlas-funded.x:Minimum payout: $100 profit ($50 on 1-Step/2-Step Daily); futures min request $500 on $50K; trading-rules page states $3,000 minimum for crypto withdrawals

ment-funding.c:Crypto leverage: 1:2 (forex/CFD program); micro crypto futures on futures program
ment-funding.c:Crypto venue: CFD via DXtrade/Match-Trader/cTrader/PropX (liquidity provider feed); CME micro crypto futures on futures program

finotive-funding.Split scaling: Challenge 80%→95% via scaling; Instant Standard 75%→90%; Instant Lite 70%→85%; Pro 100% after 30 funded days while Pro status retained
finotive-funding.Leverage: up to 1:100 (2-Step Challenge); 1:50 1-Step Challenge/Pro; 1:33 Instant Standard & 2-Step Solo; 1:25 Instant Lite
finotive-funding.Payout frequency: First payout on demand once funded and minimum profitable days met (Instant: after first profitable trades); then every 7 days (Instant Lite every 14 days; 2-Step Solo first after 14 days, then weekly)
finotive-funding.Consistency rule: No consistency rule on Challenge or Instant; Pro accounts from funded day 31 must keep weekly trade count and instrument volume within ±25% of historical averages. Profit-concentration/single-trade rules apply before payouts.
finotive-funding.Restricted countries: Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk People's Republic, Luhansk People's Republic, Palestinian Territory
finotive-funding.x:Reset / retry: No fixed reset fee published. Rapid Reset (2-Step only): Phase 1 Rapid Rebuy at 40% off the standard price; Phase 2 Continuation and Funded Recovery priced in dashboard. Paid Account Refresh for funded Challenge/Pro accounts near max drawdown (price shown in dashboard).
finotive-funding.x:Fee refund: Challenge: fee refunded automatically if funded and account in net profit on day 30 after funding. Pro: fee refunded once funded and in profit after 30 days. 2-Step Solo: refunded on first approved reward payment. Instant Funding: non-refundable except cooling-off conditions.
finotive-funding.x:Minimum payout: 1% of initial balance (Instant, no cap); 1-Step Challenge/Pro: lower of 1% or $100; 2-Step Challenge/Pro: no minimum
finotive-funding.c:Crypto venue: Simulated CFD on MT5 / Match-Trader (Finotive Markets liquidity)
finotive-funding.c:Weekend crypto: Crypto may trade 24/7 depending on symbol; weekend-holding restriction on Instant accounts excludes crypto positions

funded-trading-plus.Consistency rule: 1-Step & Instant: none; 2-Step: no day >35% of profit in each challenge step, >50% on funded; Activation Accounts: 25% on funded (checked at payout)
